Title: Tom and Jerry
Description: A mischievous mouse and a determined house cat are constantly outsmarting and chasing each other in comic adventures.

Title: Toy Story
Description: A group of toys secretly comes to life when humans are not around. Cowboy Woody and space ranger Buzz learn to work together.

Title: Tinker Bell
Description: Tinker Bell, a curious and inventive fairy, discovers her talents and explores the magical world of Pixie Hollow.

Title: Winnie the Pooh
Description: Pooh Bear and his friends in the Hundred Acre Wood share gentle adventures about friendship, kindness, and everyday discoveries.

Title: The Wild Robot
Description: A robot named Roz becomes stranded in the wilderness and learns to survive, build relationships, and care for an orphaned gosling.

Title: Barbie Fairytopia
Description: Elina, a wingless fairy, sets out on a journey through Fairytopia to help save her magical home.

Title: Finding Dory
Description: Forgetful blue tang Dory sets off to find her family, with help from Marlin, Nemo, and new friends.

Title: Finding Nemo
Description: After his son Nemo is captured by a diver, cautious clownfish Marlin crosses the ocean with Dory to find him.

Title: Minions
Description: The lovable yellow Minions search for a leader and become involved in a series of chaotic adventures.

Title: Doraemon
Description: A robotic cat from the future uses amazing gadgets from his four-dimensional pocket to help schoolboy Nobita with everyday problems.

Title: Ben 10
Description: A boy named Ben Tennyson discovers the Omnitrix, a device that lets him transform into different alien heroes.

Title: Trolls
Description: Poppy and Branch embark on adventures filled with music, friendship, and colorful Troll communities.

Title: Happy Feet
Description: Mumble is a young emperor penguin who cannot sing like the others but discovers that he can express himself through dancing.

Title: Ice Age
Description: During the Ice Age, a woolly mammoth, a sloth, and a saber-toothed tiger travel together while protecting a human baby.

Title: Upin & Ipin
Description: Twin brothers Upin and Ipin experience everyday life, friendship, and fun adventures with their family and village friends.

Title: Inside Out
Description: Inside the mind of a young girl named Riley, her emotions work together as she adjusts to a major change in her life.

Title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
Description: Teenagers Marinette and Adrien protect Paris as superheroes Ladybug and Cat Noir while keeping their identities secret.

Title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
Description: Three singing chipmunks—Alvin, Simon, and Theodore—get into comic adventures with their human caretaker, Dave.

Title: Mr. Bean: The Animated Series
Description: The famously accident-prone Mr. Bean turns ordinary tasks into funny mishaps through his unusual ideas and expressive behavior.

Title: Ratatouille
Description: Remy, a rat with an extraordinary sense of smell and a passion for cooking, dreams of becoming a chef in Paris.

Title: Up
Description: An elderly widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and sets off on an unexpected journey with a young scout.

Title: Monsters, Inc.
Description: Monsters generate power by collecting children's screams, but two monster friends rethink their work after a little girl enters their world.

Title: Abominable
Description: A teenage girl and her friends help a young yeti named Everest return to his home across the beautiful landscapes of China.

Title: SpongeBob SquarePants
Description: SpongeBob, an enthusiastic sea sponge, enjoys life in Bikini Bottom with his friends and coworkers.

Title: Scooby-Doo
Description: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. team travel around solving spooky cases and uncovering the people behind seemingly supernatural events.

Title: Dragon Ball
Description: Young martial artist Goku sets out on adventures to find the Dragon Balls and meets friends and powerful opponents along the way.

Title: Courage the Cowardly Dog
Description: Courage, a timid pink dog, protects his owners from strange creatures and unsettling events in the middle of nowhere.

Title: Kung Fu Panda
Description: Po, a noodle-loving panda, unexpectedly becomes the Dragon Warrior and trains to protect the Valley of Peace.

Title: The Lion King
Description: Young lion Simba faces loss and responsibility as he grows toward accepting his place in the Circle of Life.

Title: Turning Red
Description: Thirteen-year-old Mei Lee discovers that strong emotions cause her to transform into a giant red panda, complicating family and school life.

Title: Coco
Description: Aspiring musician Miguel enters the Land of the Dead and uncovers the story of his family and its connection to music.

Title: Zootopia
Description: Judy Hopps, a determined rabbit police officer, teams up with fox Nick Wilde to solve a mystery in the animal city of Zootopia.
